_about: Strings of the Knowledge graph section.
graph.about: Cards and the links between them — what the base actually says: links in the text and the related field. A way to reach a card, not a report: communities, bridges and islands are computed by kb:map.
graph.around: Around «{id}»: {n} cards, {depth} steps. Right-click a node to stand in it.
graph.counts: Cards {nodes}, links {edges}, with no link at all {orphans}.
graph.hub: «{id}» has {n} neighbours within {depth} steps. The layout will take a few seconds; spread helps pull the nodes apart.
graph.nocard: There is no card «{id}» in the base.
graph.nolib: The graph library did not load: is the cockpit/vendor/cytoscape folder in place?
graph.pick_project: Pick a project — files are shown for the selected one.
graph.stale: Showing the previous graph: the recompute did not pass — {why}
graph.title: Knowledge graph
graph.toobig: {n} cards — the layout will take a few seconds, and without spread it will be a tangle.
graph.help.depth.what: How many link steps from the selected card to show.
graph.help.depth.result: The card, its neighbours and their neighbours.
graph.help.spread_out.how: Labels overlap — press “+” a couple of times.
graph.help.spread_out.result: A roomier graph; the number shows the current spread.
graph.help.spread_in.how: The graph does not fit the screen — press “−”.
graph.help.spread_in.result: A more compact graph with shorter edges.
graph.help.all.what: Show the whole base at once, without a selected card.
graph.help.all.result: All cards and links; if there are too many — a warning and “Show anyway”.
graph.help.rebuild.what: Recompute the graph from the current base.
graph.help.rebuild.how: After “Update base” or a repair: the graph is shown from a saved computation.
graph.help.rebuild.result: The timestamp updates; new cards and links are in place.
graph.help.anyway.what: Draw the graph even though it is over the limit.
graph.help.anyway.how: You need the whole picture, not one card.
graph.help.anyway.result: Takes longer to draw; “+” spreads the nodes so it can be read.
